request: Implement slugifyModelName(value) in eval/workflow-bench/fixtures/pilot-001/slugify.mjs. For string input, normalize with Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks, lowercase, replace every run of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen, and trim leading or trailing hyphens. For non-string or empty input, return an empty string. Do not add dependencies.

acceptanceCriteria.description: String inputs become lowercase ASCII kebab-case with repeated separators collapsed and edge separators removed.
NFKD normalization and combining-mark removal preserve the base ASCII letters of accented Latin input.
Non-string and empty inputs return an empty string.
The implementation has no external dependency or dynamic code execution.
